reconstruction_notes.en: Original7m-wide representative shore-platform patch: a broad low gently seaward-sloping abrasion bench remains continuous with a retreated rear cliff face, with restrained shallow weathered pans and one joint. Clear cropped bedrock sides and back, no high waterfall stair, tiny isolated stone or sea-stack substitution. NPS coastal context and primary GSA shore-platform/cliff study consulted. Nominal dimensions, local slope, palette and layout are art choices, not a mapped ancient site, exact tide level or fluid simulation.

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish long parallel ribbed shell shafts connected by broad repeated hairpin bends in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以平行长肋管由宽大重复发夹弯相连搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

assets.origin: ground-center (or documented mounting point)

reconstruction_notes.en: Original shell-only concept with parallel growing shafts, two broad hairpin turns, open gaps and integral restrained ribs. The real aperture is recessed; fine sutures and chambers simplified. Nominal0.9m longest span is display art scale, not a species measurement. No soft body or swimming mechanism claimed.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创壳体概念：平行渐粗长管、两处宽发夹弯、清楚间隙及克制实体肋纹，末端有真实凹入壳口。细缝合线和腔室简化，0.9米为名义展示尺度，非物种实测；不添加软体或运动机制。

scientific_scope.en: Generic low-centered ice-wedge polygon ground teaching module. NPS Swanson explains contraction cracks, repeated freezing and raised margins around lower wetter centers; aerial photos establish irregular connected networks. Nominal45x40m footprint,3m cut soil section and0.7m relief artistic, not surveyed study site, age or current permafrost trend. Ice wedges are buried, no exposed surface ice required. File-space dimensions are exported geometry bounds, not real-world specimen/locality measurements. Catalogue category is navigation only, not a claim of settled biological affinity.
scientific_scope.zh: 仅限风格化教学与形态研究，不代表精确标本或特定地点的测量。尺寸、配色与简化具有示意性；原始简报、来源和独立审查中的不确定性与限制保持适用。 导出文件包围尺寸不等同真实标本或地点测量；目录分组仅供浏览，不代表已确定的生物亲缘归属。

description.en: Evidence-informed whole-organism outline reconstruction of Thaumaptilon walcotti, not a modern sea pen or exact specimen replica. Nominal212mm height references ROM complete holotype USNM468028; width50mm follows reported maximum, thickness/color/pose are artistic. Morphological affinity remains disputed: ROM describes historical stem-cnidarian interpretation, Hoyal Cuthill2022 supports Petalonamae. Neither is asserted as settled. Basal anchoring interpretation and pustules-as-zooids uncertain; no feeding tentacles invented.

anatomy: Semioval smooth vaulted shield; eyes not evidenced. Eleven free rear tergites: reduced concealed first, eight preabdominal and three postabdominal segments overall; tapering telson with two short terminal points.

Seven prosomal appendage pairs: elongated flexible chelicerae with tiny terminal chela; limbs2-5 each have separately inserting inner and outer rami; limb6 inner ramus only, nonchelate terminal; limb7 small spine-fringed flap.
Inner rami2-5 six podomeres plus terminal claw; outer rami shorter, five podomeres with terminal spine brushes. Six paired lamellate gill groups under preabdomen; attachment uncertain.
restoration_boundaries: Images are serial-grinding digital fossil reconstructions, not unprocessed photographs or artistic concept evidence. Distinct color segmentation in atlas is not biological coloration.
No copying research meshes/STL; construct original low-poly geometry from cited morphology. No new eyes, giant genal horns, fused modern horseshoe rear shield or scorpion sting.
Restore neutral symmetric stance instead of preserving taphonomic crossed/asymmetric limbs; exact minor joint angles, lamella count simplification, thickness and muted color are artistic choices.
Atlas figure3 A/B only match holotype; C/D/E other animals excluded.

scale.note: 23.2mm and 9.2mm directly published same specimen. Other lengths are conservative modeling partitions estimated from same-specimen images; adjust to total, not independent measurements. Vaulted height inferred ~4mm; no foreign specimen scale.

anatomy: High arch/box-like cephalic shield with an open anterior gape. Reduced tapering rear body, free anterior tergites then compact fused posterior unit, narrow articulated tail spine. Not modern horseshoe outline.

Seven cephalic appendage pairs: slender long chelicerae; pairsII-V robust segmented brush-bearing exopods pointing forward/up and ventrally oriented endopods. Separate body-wall insertion for inner/outer branches per2012 revision, not forks on leg shafts.
PairVI locomotory inner branch with small outer tendril interpretation rather than a fifth large brush; pairVII short flap-like. Preserve small conservative terminals, not giant claws.

Use2013 revised dorsal counting: four anterior tergites (the fourth previously grouped posteriorly), three fused posterior segments, separate telson-base boss not counted as an eighth trunk segment. Six paired ventral opercula: first three more developed respiratory lamellae, last three reduced covers.
restoration_boundaries: Fig4 is a fossil-derived digital reconstruction, not an ordinary surface photo or color evidence. Build original geometry, never import published reconstruction mesh.
Unknown accession of Fig4 remains unknown; C.29557 in2025 Fig1C/2C-D is same-species anatomical comparator and visibly smaller, not the7mm measured individual.
Brush feeding function is hypothesis, not behavior proven by fossil; stance/color and minor missing fine bristles inferred. No invented compound eyes.
2025 figures contain modern shrimp and other genera: only Offacolus1C and2C-D informative here.

scale.uncertainty: 7mm is rounded caption length; component dimensions approximate same image proportions, not caliper measurements. Live posture and oblique image imply ~20percent proportional uncertainty.

evidence_anchors.cranial: Rieppel1994 Fig8 actual photographs SMNS10360 dorsal/ventral,50mmbar; Fig9 interpretive sutures. Broad short snout without nothosaur rostral constriction; low broad skull and blunt striated crowns diagnosis.
evidence_anchors.incomplete_parts: Tail/neck counts, distal phalangeal formula, soft tissue and pigmentation are uncertain; reconstruct conservatively from same-genus Fig36 and mounted layout, not invent fossil preservation.
evidence_anchors.museum: Ghedoghedo2010 photo of Stuttgart mounted skeleton, real photograph but reconstructed/composite display, no readable accession. Do NOT claim this is complete original SMNS14733 or measure total from perspectival photograph.
evidence_anchors.postcranial: Rieppel1994 SMNS14733 measured associated postcranial bones; Fig36 explicit skeletal RECONSTRUCTION, not actual complete fossil. 2024 Cabezuelo-Hernandez et al same-genus comparison confirms32-34dorsals in GPIT-PV31566, incomplete neck/tail in both principal skeletons.
evidence_anchors.taxonomic_boundary: S.gaillardoti valid2024 Simosauridae; Paludidraco is separate filter-feeding genus, NOT geometry source. Rieppel1994 treats guilielmi synonym; original holotype gaillardoti lost.

morphology: Whole animal, low broad bluntly rounded triangular head, no needle snout or bulbous frog head. No constricted rostrum. Eyes dorsolateral anterior to large posterior cheek region; cover all bony fenestrae with flesh.
Moderately elongate neck distinctly narrower than torso, shorter than torso and smoothly blended. Broad ribcage, robust elongated trunk. No giant plesiosaur swan neck.

Exactly four short robust limbs. Forelimbs stronger and longer than hindlimbs, humerus/femur ratio1.28 supports distinction. Bent upper/lower limb sections lead into five-digit swimming hands/feet. Do not turn entire limbs into dolphin paddles.

Five digits per limb; degree of webbing, distal digit lengths and small terminal claws are uncertain. Use conservative partly webbed broad hands/feet with five short visible tips, no exaggerated talons or invented hyperphalangy. Not direct skin evidence.

Continuous long tapering tail with no imposed fluke, dorsal fin, crest, plates or spines. Neck/tail exact lengths are inferred, not claimed preserved. Gentle near-horizontal swimming pose, no rigid extreme neck bend.
Slight jaw opening to show a few short stout broad blunt crowns, not needle fangs, large tusks or flat placodont paving teeth. Tooth number is visual simplification, not counted complete dentition.
Neutral muted grey-brown dorsal and lighter ventral colors are artistic inference, no bold unsupported markings. No exposed skeleton, mount supports, slab, labels or props.
must_not: No Paludidraco anatomy or filter comb; no Nothosaurus needle fangs/waisted rostrum.
No scientific claim of direct soft-tissue preservation or complete original mounted specimen.
Do not reproduce fossil breaks, fenestra holes, missing skull bones or museum armatures.

anatomy: Smooth laterally compressed shrimp-like carapace with anterior eye notch, paired stalked eyes and narrow rostrum about0.59ofcarapace, not the carapace-length rostrum of Lobetelson.
Six distinct curved abdominal somites with deep ventrally pointed pleura and subtle anterior excavations. First five carry paired simplified swimming flaps, sixth carries tail fan.

Eight paired robust single-branched thoracic walking limbs. Relatively stout intermediate joints, long merus/propodus; no giant lobster chelae and no added maxilliped pair. Two paired anterior antennal systems, fine flagella simplified.

Tail has strongly sclerotized blade-like outer uropods and spined inner rami, not broad rounded paddles. Outer ramus about1.5timesinner. Central narrow triangular telson tapers abruptly near distalquarter, with paired rearward small furcal projections.
restoration_boundaries: Real MPM P25899.1/.2 counterpart photographs document body curvature, segment outline and visible appendages. They have unlabeled scale bars; filename5cm is not accepted as a calibrated measurement. Do not apply PRI76753 4.5cm to this specimen.
2025 Figure5 ONLY panels1and6 are target species restoration. Panel2 BearGulch quoted magister is probably different species, panels3and7 B.traquairi, panels4/5/8 Lobetelson; never mix these.

2006 Figure1 ONLY panelC is target tail; large whole-body panelA and broadtailB are Lobetelson and must not be copied. The published reconstruction supplies missing anatomy, not a claim all features survive in MPM P25899.

Original generic broad tail fan is superseded by revised blade/spike fan diagnosis while retaining complete original organism and period. Muted color and standing/swimming pose are artistic, not pigment evidence.

scale.uncertainty: Published means are population anchors, not exact specimen. Remaining dimensions approximate +/-20percent; body width and living depth not recoverable directly from flattened photographs.

scientific_limits.en: Scale uses published averages from about twenty specimens: carapace16.68mm and rostrum9.84mm, not measurements of pictured MPM P25899. Other dimensions are conservative proportional estimates. Living width, pose and color are inferred. The original broad-tail-fan planning description is corrected to the revised species blade-like, pointed tail fan.
scientific_limits.zh: 尺度采用文献约20件标本的平均背甲16.68毫米、吻9.84毫米，不冒充照片MPM P25899的单体实测。其他尺度是保守比例估计，活体宽度、姿态和颜色为推断。原规划宽尾扇按修订改为该种的尖刃状尾扇。

evidence_anchors.armour: Figs4–8 real photos plus separately labelled interpretative drawings establish large near-round maincarapace, separate smaller pelvicshield, decreasing tailplates. Fig9 is author LIFE RECONSTRUCTION, not fossil photograph; Fig10.1 is revised anatomical synthesis, Fig10.2 the old comparison to avoid copying.
evidence_anchors.current_taxon: Gere et al2024 open article continues C.hildegardis and studies placodont crushing dentition. Do not adopt historical speculative herbivory or mix cranial anatomy from other listed genera.
evidence_anchors.scale: Table1 T58 specimen approx215mm long ×230mm wide; interpretative Fig10.1 approx205×215mm. Adopt205×215mm nominal living mainshield, with observed measurement uncertainty stated.
evidence_anchors.skull: Neil Pezzoni2021 actual PIMUZ T4763 skull photograph, same holotype as Fig2.1; short broadly triangular posterior skull and compact rostrum. Fossil fractures/temporal openings are not skinholes.
evidence_anchors.whole: Scheyer2010 Fig2 actual photographs: PIMUZ T4763 holotype dorsal and PIMUZ T58 ventral,10cm bars. Fig3 juvenile MSNM V458 is a cast, not primary adult photo. These are articulated but incomplete/disturbed, not complete pristine bodies.

morphology: Whole compact low-bodied aquatic reptile, not a turtle or broad ray: main near-circular shallowly domed oval shield about0.95 length/width; separate smaller pelvic shield behind it.

Maintain a narrow flexible skin band between shields, visible especially fromtop/oblique. No detached floating shell and no through-body hole; fossil postmortem separation must not become exaggerated live gap.

Mainshield has small enlarged triangular/scalloped lateral plates of broadly similar size; pelvicshield sideplates taper posteriorly. Avoid enormous sawblade spikes or front carapace horns. Interior tile layout is simplified uncertain armour, not a claimed turtle scute formula.

Short broad triangular head with compact snout and fleshed-over temporal region; no Placochelys needle-like beak and no Henodus transverse square shovel muzzle. Closed mouth with no protrudingfangs; crushing teeth internal.

Short exposed neck, four short splayed limbs under lateral shell margins. Feet unknown: five short rounded minimally webbed tips each are explicitly inferred; do not create sea-turtle flippers or assert fossil phalangealformula.
Tapering short tail relative to long-tailed placodonts, with four diminishing armour rows: one dorsal, one ventral and two lateral. No tailclub, dorsalfin or fishfluke.

No belly plastron: soft ventral surface with gastral support not externally exposed bones. No specimen slab, labels or skeleton openings. Muted brown-gray keratinous armour and subdued lighter skin are artistic inferred colors.

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: two-part armored shell and a compact broad head.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：两部分组成的甲壳与紧凑宽头。

scale.basis: Mainshield dimension measured/estimated in Scheyer2010 Table1. Other dimensions are approximate model targets from Fig9 interpreted shape normalized to205mm mainshield; not independent fossil measurements. Do not use Paul0.75m T58 entry labelled muensteri as taxonomic authority.

scientific_limits.en: The adult fossils are incomplete and disturbed. Two shields and four-row tail armour have direct fossil support, but shield interiors and original separation are uncertain. Carapace size is directly grounded in T58; total length and head/tail proportions are inferred from Scheyer2010 reconstruction, not an intact measured individual. Feet are unknown in this species; five short minimally webbed tips are a conservative tetrapod inference, not preserved anatomy. Body depth, eye aperture, soft skin and colors are inferred. No ventral plastron is supported.
scientific_limits.zh: 成人标本不完整且有移位。双盾及四列尾甲有真化石依据，盾内甲片布置和原间距不确定。主甲尺度依据T58；总长及头尾比例据Scheyer2010复原推算，不称完整个体实测。本种足部未知，五短指与最低限度蹼缘仅四足类保守推定而非保存解剖。体高、外眼、皮肤和颜色推定，无腹甲证据。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole adult Cyamodus hildegardis reconstruction, combining explicitly identified specimens T4763 and T58 from the same species; skeletal evidence plus bounded soft-tissue inference, not a fossil scan or skull-only substitute.

acceptance: Top and perspective must plainly show large mainshield and separate smaller pelvicshield with narrow skin joint, not a colored seam on a single turtle shell.
Head broad posteriorly and compact triangular, not the Henodus square snout or Placochelys elongatedrostrum.
Tail has decreasing armour rows, four complete limbs, no plastron or flipper substitution.
Do not mistake Fig1 oldsinglearmor or Fig10.2 oldoverbroad reconstruction for the selected evidence.
shape_gate.comparisons: Henodus: single very broad rectangular carapace and square transverse head versus Cyamodus near-round mainshield plus pelvicshield and triangular compact head. Placochelys: elongated single carapace interpretation and long toothless rostrum versus shorter broad head and splitshield. ScheyerTable1 directly contrasts ratios0.95 Cyamodus,0.77 Henodus,1.4 Placochelys (last is interpretation only).
shape_gate.required_combination: Two distinct dorsal armour units plus compact broad head, whole organism retained.

frozen_scientific_scope.taxonomic_note: Use C.hildegardis as Scheyer2010 and Gere et al2024. Earlier proposed synonymy with C.laticeps/C.muensteri is acknowledged, not used to import another species anatomy or create another asset. ID remains cyamodus.

Not a scanned complete soft-tissue specimen.","scientific_limits":{"en":"OR2003 is a flattened historical mounted skeleton, not a three-dimensional body mould; restored bone intervals and spread ribs are not exact living dimensions. Larkin et al2023 report6.83m skeletal length. Flesh thickness, body width, fin soft margins, dorsal fin, upper tail lobe and color are inferred. Comparative R122 tooth/R123 jaw are different individuals. Paul table R1157 assignment is not used because R1157 belongs to T.eurycephalus. Historical risor skull photograph is excluded from modeling rather than assuming disputed synonymy.","zh":"OR2003是压扁并装架的历史骨架，不是三维软体模具，补配处及铺开的肋骨不能当活体精确尺寸。Larkin等2023报告骨架长6.83米。肉体厚度、宽度、鳍缘、背鳍、尾上叶及颜色推定。R122牙与R123下颌为不同个体；不使用Paul表R1157的归属和8.5米数值，R1157属T.eurycephalus。旧risor头骨照片排除建模，不凭有争议同义关系套用。"},"name":{"en":"Temnodontosaurus","zh":"Temnodontosaurus（海生爬行类）"},"taxon":"Temnodontosaurus platyodon","classification":"Reptilia; Ichthyosauria; Neoichthyosauria","era":"jurassic","reconstruction_type":"whole-organism","original_scope":{"en":"Planned animal asset: large tooth-bearing skull and deep robust body.","zh":"规划中的动物资产：大型有齿头骨与深厚躯干。"},"evidence_anchors":{"body":"Emoke Denes2018 photo7 actual NHM skeleton numbered2003 above lower skull/partial column; upper specimen gives long skull, substantial ribcage and four long paddles. Lower specimen is not appended as another head. Photo8 a separate upper displayed T.platyodon skeleton (consistent with OR2918 placement, accession not independently readable) supplies only supplementary tailbend/limb layout, not OR2003 measurements.","scale":"Larkin et al2023 Excavating the Rutland Sea Dragon, comparison section explicitly OR2003=6.83m; OR2918 separately approximately6m. evidence_anchors.body: Emoke Denes2018 photo7 actual NHM skeleton numbered2003 above lower skull/partial column; upper specimen gives long skull, substantial ribcage and four long paddles. Lower specimen is not appended as another head. Photo8 a separate upper displayed T.platyodon skeleton (consistent with OR2918 placement, accession not independently readable) supplies only supplementary tailbend/limb layout, not OR2003 measurements.
evidence_anchors.classification: Martin et al2012 recognizes T.platyodon as type species and discusses carinate teeth/large prey niche; use only its T.platyodon comparison, not new T.azerguensis long slender tooth-reduced skull.
evidence_anchors.fins: Original photos show long narrow paddles and substantial hindfins, not Ophthalmosaurus tiny hindpaddles. Martin2012 non-thunnosaurian fore/hind broadly comparable; do not make exact equal-length claim from distorted mount.
evidence_anchors.scale: Larkin et al2023 Excavating the Rutland Sea Dragon, comparison section explicitly OR2003=6.83m; OR2918 separately approximately6m. The Rutland10m skeleton itself is not this model.
evidence_anchors.teeth: Godefroit1993 actual R122 tooth Plate8C-D3cm bar and Fig16; crown laterally compressed, spatulate pointed cutting outline. R123 lower jaw Plate8A-B. Text reports such cutting crowns in BMNH2003 too. These are not narrow pin teeth or blunt molar plates.

morphology: Large robust elongated tooth-bearing head transitions without an exposed long neck into a deep muscular streamlined torso. Rostrum long but substantial, not needlethin Leptonectes or short broad T.eurycephalus.

Conspicuous pointed cutting crowns with broad bases and modest labiolingual compression. Use approximately28 visible teeth per jaw side as simplified representation, not an established exact count; larger mid-row crowns. Jaws open about12degrees to expose real tooth-bearing gate without giant tusks. No serration detail invented at low-poly scale.

Deep fusiform torso carries strong dorsal and ventral mass, not a skeletal slab or thin cylinder. Ribcage spread does not directly set body width. No fossil matrix/support rods or open cranial fenestrae.

Four long tapered paddles, hindpair substantial and only moderately smaller than forepair. Smooth fleshed continuous fin membranes without separate clawed toes, not enormous broad round Ophthalmosaurus forefins with minute hindfins.

Long muscular tail stock tapers to a downturned skeletal lower lobe with a modest inferred upper soft-tissue lobe. Vertical tail plane, never horizontal cetacean flukes. Dorsal fin modest and swept, explicitly inferred, no soft-tissue claim from OR2003.
Paired lateral eyes considerably smaller externally than skeletal orbital openings; avoid huge googly scleral plates. Restrained dark gray-brown dorsum/light ventrum is artistic inference.

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: large tooth-bearing skull and deep robust body.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：大型有齿头骨与深厚躯干。

scale.interpretation: Only published6.83m is reported skeleton measurement. All subordinate targets are conservative modeled proportions, not caliper readings from OR2003. Three-dimensional body volume and soft fin outlines inferred. Skull occupies roughly24percent of full length; orbit/jaw ratio about0.18, not Ophthalmosaurus0.28.

scientific_limits.en: OR2003 is a flattened historical mounted skeleton, not a three-dimensional body mould; restored bone intervals and spread ribs are not exact living dimensions. Larkin et al2023 report6.83m skeletal length. Flesh thickness, body width, fin soft margins, dorsal fin, upper tail lobe and color are inferred. Comparative R122 tooth/R123 jaw are different individuals. Paul table R1157 assignment is not used because R1157 belongs to T.eurycephalus. Historical risor skull photograph is excluded from modeling rather than assuming disputed synonymy.
scientific_limits.zh: OR2003是压扁并装架的历史骨架，不是三维软体模具，补配处及铺开的肋骨不能当活体精确尺寸。Larkin等2023报告骨架长6.83米。肉体厚度、宽度、鳍缘、背鳍、尾上叶及颜色推定。R122牙与R123下颌为不同个体；不使用Paul表R1157的归属和8.5米数值，R1157属T.eurycephalus。旧risor头骨照片排除建模，不凭有争议同义关系套用。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Temnodontosaurus platyodon with body layout and scale anchored to NHMUK PV OR2003; same-species comparative skull/tooth material used with specimen boundaries explicit. Not a scanned complete soft-tissue specimen.

acceptance: Lateral and perspective reveal broad-based cutting tooth row and large skull merging into deep muscular body.
Top shows substantial rostrum/head and body width plus four long tapered fins, not needlejaw.
Hindpaddles clearly substantial relative to forepaddles, paired eyes not enormous exposed orbital rings.
No R1157/T.eurycephalus, risor juvenile, azerguensis toothless rostrum, trigonodon mount, or Rutland10m specimen substitution.
shape_gate.comparisons: Ophthalmosaurus has much larger relative orbit, broad forefins and markedly reduced hindfins; Stenopterygius has narrower overall head/body and adult tooth reduction. Temnodontosaurus must retain large visible cutting teeth, robust skull and deep volume plus substantial hindpaddles, not merely scaled existing fishbody.
shape_gate.required_combination: Large robust tooth-bearing skull and deep powerful torso, with substantial four-paddle plan; complete animal retained.

diagnostic_targets: Elongate relatively narrow face with high retracted nasal region and a short flexible upper lip; no long elephant trunk or massive round wombat snout.
Long powerful forelimbs have bent and outward-set elbows; do not make four vertical rhino columns or a knuckle-walking sloth.
Several clearly separated long sickle-like foreclaws: deep in side view but laterally thin, not round bear nails or broad digging shovels.
Massive long torso and strong neck, narrower hindlimb stance than forelimbs; no kangaroo jumping posture.
Hindfeet support coherent whole-body stance, joints distinct, no hooves. Fine digit identities incompletely known, do not claim exact recovered manus.
Neutral understated coat, small rounded ears and moderate tapering tail are original soft-tissue inferences.

High retracted nasals do not establish a trunk: Museums Victoria favors a mobile lip/tongue. Elbow posture follows2021 range-of-motion study, not absolute joint fusion. Digit allocation and claw sheaths are incomplete/inferred; the real unguals figured are unassociated.

anatomy: Two large flight-wing pairs attached to meso/metathorax, widest near base then markedly narrowing in apical third. Hindwings slightly wider; major vein branches plus simplified crossvein network, not arbitrary dragonfly needles.
Paired cordate prothoracic lobes anterior to flight wings, about two-thirds forewing width, fan-like vein relief. These are small winglets, not a third equal flight pair or dorsal shield.
Small head with broad clypeal region, pair of eyes and antennae, forward/downward sucking beak with paired palps. Do not replace with chewing beetle mandibles.

Three thoracic segments with median grooves, robust sculpted dorsal cuticle; abdomen slightly broader than thorax, overlapping transverse tergites with modest pointed posterolateral corners and oblique strengthening ridges. No free gill paddles.
Three pairs of short articulated legs, five-part tarsal construction and tiny claws. Limbs arranged so wing bases do not hide every leg in all views.

Female-mode tail: pair of long tapering robust cerci and a modest separate curved ovipositor. Never add spinosa male claspers to lobata-based female. Cerci length and ovipositor distal completion explicitly inferred.
restoration_boundaries: Actual MNHN.F.R51415 museum photograph viewed, showing body and wings in slab; repository record gives lobata holotype and same taxonomic history as Brongniart22-1. Photo is real fossil, not reconstructed anatomy.
Kukalova1970 Fig51 and p12 fix lobata22-1 head, main wings, thorax, abdomen and female terminal bases. Published66×17.5mmforewing,39mmabdomen,7.8/7.2mmthorax.
Fig50 is explicitly a genus composite, NOT actual fossil: S.pygmaea winglet outline; S.oustaleti/S.agnita legs and five-segment tarsi; S.laurentiauxi beak.

Original author used other palaeodictyopterans to estimate incomplete structures: Eugereon palpal length, broader group labrum, Homaloneura ovipositor length. Keep these as approximate functional completion, not species diagnosis or directly measured lobata features.

Handlirsch/Sharov popular reconstructions were criticized in revision. Avoid dorsal shield mistaken from ventral view, broad untapered wings, exaggerated free abdominal gills and mixed male/female genitalia.
The model fulfills original complete genus-level gate; it does not assert a definitive modern phylogenetic interpretation of abdominal expansions. Color, body thickness and flight pose artistic.

scale.uncertainty: Body length sums measured segments plus estimated prothorax; cerci full length and depth not preserved measurements. Use actual wing dimensions, not generic giant-insect maximum.

Depth, color, posture and unseen distal proportions remain inferred.

description.en: A complete Sphecoptera reconstruction with four narrow wings and long paired tail filaments. Based on an incomplete compression fossil, it infers body depth and missing appendage details; original colour and sex are unknown.
description.zh: Sphecoptera的完整复原，具有四片狭长翅与长双尾丝。依据不完整压印化石，体厚和缺失附肢细节为推断，原色与性别未知。

anatomy: Four elongated wings in two thoracic pairs. Proximal portion narrow and stalk-like, broaden toward outer middle then rounded distal ends; preserve open gaps between pairs.
Slim thorax and distinctly segmented slender abdomen; no dragonfly-thick body, no wasp waist and no extra pair of prothoracic winglets borrowed from Homoioptera.
Paired very long slender cerci from posterior abdominal tip, slightly diverging; do not add a third mayfly tail filament.
Three pairs of small articulated walking legs; these are conservative group-level completions, not six fully preserved limbs claimed in the specimen.
Small head, paired modest eyes, short conservative antennae and small ventral sucking rostrum. Fine mouthparts are not asserted as visible in the photo.

Use low-contrast alternating dark/light wing patches matching the major observed pattern; original colors unknown. Simplify venation into sparse longitudinal branching, not dense invented diagnostic counts.
restoration_boundaries: MNHN catalog explicitly identifies R51337 as lectotype and incomplete; retain both facts. Public exhibit image matches distinctive slab cracks and explains newly exposed left wing ends and cerci.
Catalog ethanol photo with centimeter ruler is size anchor; public exhibit closeup gives clearer silhouette and patch pattern, without an independent scale.
Do not mix brongniartiana R51307, a separate single-wing species, or other Sphecoptera species. No claim they are synonyms.
Planar wing outline, body and long paired cerci observed; living depth, postural symmetry, missing distal appendages and exact endpoint lengths inferred. No exact sex-specific terminalia.
Museum interpretation of paleopterous spread wings is used for posture; hovering and disruptive camouflage remain interpretation, not directly demonstrated physiology.

scale.uncertainty: Approximately15percent on planar image measurements. Wet photo ruler ticks about73pixels per centimeter at800px width; head to abdominal tip roughly270px, crosswingextent roughly720px. Cerci preserved beyond abdominal tip roughly200px;35mm chosen conservative tapered completion. No precision claim.

scientific_limits.en: Interpretive living restoration of an incomplete compression fossil. Body38mm and wingspan100mm are approximate image estimates from the centimeter ruler in the same specimen ethanol photo, not published caliper measurements. Cerci35mm each include conservative missing-end completion; depth, antennae and incompletely visible walking legs are inferred. Original hues and sex are unknown. No hovering performance is experimentally demonstrated by this model.
scientific_limits.zh: 不完整压印化石的活体解释复原。体长38毫米、展翅100毫米来自同标本乙醇照片厘米尺估计，非论文卡尺实测；双尾各35毫米包含保守缺失末端补配。体厚、触角和不清晰步足为推断，原色及性别未知，模型不证明实际悬停性能。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete Carboniferous insect with four narrow, long-petioled wings, slender segmented abdomen and long paired tail filaments. Anchor: MNHN.F.R51337 lectotype, not the differently named single-wing species S. brongniartiana.

description.en: A terrestrial predator reconstruction with a large elongated head, shearing cheek teeth and a long balancing tail. Body size, soft tissues, ears, coat and colour are reconstruction estimates, not measurements of one complete skeleton.
description.zh: 陆生捕食者的完整复原，具有大型狭长头部、剪切型颊齿与长平衡尾。体型、软组织、耳、毛被和颜色为复原估计，并非单个完整骨架的实测。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Hyaenodonta, Hyaenodontidae; not Hyaenidae or modern Carnivora. Creodonta is historical grouping.
diagnostic_targets: Large long skull relative to torso, deep jaw behind long muzzle; not modern hyena short head or oversized sabrecat canine display.
Show enlarged blade-like shearing cheek teeth behind canines in modestly open mouth; teeth gate cannot vanish behind closed lips.
Long tapered muscular tail clearly distinct from short hyena tail.
Moderately elongated low torso and substantial semi-digitigrade limbs with differentiated wrist/hock, no tall slender wolf silhouette.
Small restrained ears and neutral inferred fur; no striped/spotted modern hyena coat or dramatic mane.
Complete original animal, not skull-only, preserve longhead/shearingteeth/longtail combination.

scale.model_status: Absolute living dimensions chosen estimates anchored loosely to published25cm skull; named canine measurements not claims same individual.

scientific_limits.en: 2022 Fig1B is a skeletal reconstruction reproduced from Scott and Jepsen, normalized by thorax length, not an absolute scale or one confirmed complete specimen.2011 Fig8 caption gives25cm skull length but no explicit catalog identification in caption; do not equate it with SDSM3017 or493. Named tooth measurements are distinct source specimens. Full body dimensions, skin, ears, tail soft tissues and color are restoration estimates. Never scale giant Asian species or modern hyena body proportions into H.horridus.
scientific_limits.zh: 2022 Fig1B是据Scott与Jepsen的复原骨架，按胸部长度归一化，非绝对尺或已确认完整单标本。2011 Fig8标25厘米颅长但图注未具名号，不能擅定为SDSM3017/493。具名齿测量是独立标本。身体尺寸及耳皮毛尾色为复原估计，不混亚洲巨型种或现代鬣狗比例。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole terrestrial predator with proportionately large elongated head, readable shearing cheek teeth and long balancing tail.

Tooth puncture marks on a30million year old Dinictis skull
UMMP VP3731 Hyaenodon horridus

description.en: A complete hadrosaur reconstruction with an expanded tall cranial crest rather than the obsolete narrow rod. The crest combines incomplete material; missing regions, soft tissues, colour and stance are reconstructed.
description.zh: 完整鸭嘴龙类复原，采用扩展高头冠而非过时的细棒冠。头冠综合不完整材料，缺失部位、软组织、颜色与站姿为复原。

diagnostic_targets: Tall expanded lobate cranial crest with broad rounded summit and continuous connection toward snout, not solitary thin unicorn spike.
Follow2020Fig4: slightly rostrally inclined nasal support and subhorizontal caudal skull roof, not2013 posterior tilt.
Crest narrow across head in frontal view but broad in lateral view; not Corythosaurus round helmet or Parasaurolophus long back tube.
Duckbill, deep hadrosaur trunk, substantial hindlimbs, shorter forelimbs and long tapering tail.
Palms inward/functional supported forefeet without historical splayed pronated grasping hands.

scale.basis: NHM genus estimate; not measured IVPP individual or modern reconstructed crest.

scientific_limits.en: Crest reconstruction synthesizes multiple fragmentary specimens, not a complete preserved crest. Follow Zhang etal2020 Fig4 expanded crest with more rostrally inclined nasal and near-horizontal rear skull roof; white areas are reconstructed. CT shows nasal spine itself solid/sandwich-like, not a hollow pipe; this does not disprove the larger hollow crest. Body mount is composite and historically posed, with obsolete rod crest and pronated hands not adopted.12m is NHM genus estimate, not measured photographed skeleton. Soft tissue, colour and posture inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 头冠整合多个零碎标本，不是保存完整头冠。采用Zhang等2020图4较向前倾鼻突和较水平后头顶的扩展高冠，白色缺失部位为复原。CT说明鼻突骨本身为实心夹层而非空管，不等于否定整体中空头冠。躯体装架为合成及历史姿势，旧棒冠和旋前手不采用。12米为NHM属估，非照片骨架实测。软组织、颜色及站姿为推定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete hadrosaur with modern expanded tall cranial crest, dedicated2013/2020 form review, full trunk, four limbs and long tail. Never obsolete unicorn rod or skull-only object.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed2013Fig2 IVPPV725/V829 fossil photographs andFig7 reconstructed skull;2020Fig4 revised interpretation;2008Captmondo museum composite mount for torso/limb context only.

description.en: A short-headed bipedal reconstruction with featherlike body covering and a distinctly scaly long tail. It combines partial fossils; featherlike structures follow the original authors' interpretation, while density, colour, muscles and pose are inferred.
description.zh: 短头双足复原，具有羽状体被和明显覆鳞的长尾。综合部分化石，羽状结构沿用原作者解释；密度、颜色、肌肉与姿态为推断。

diagnostic_targets: Compact short skull and beaked herbivorous muzzle, short forelimbs, long hindlimbs and long tapering tail.
Fine short filament/featherlike tufts around head, neck and torso and proximal limbs; no flight-wing vanes.
Tail largely smooth-looking at distance but with readable rows of thin overlapping scales, not fluffy feather tail or thick armour.
Keep featherlike torso versus scaly-tail regional contrast clear in standard side/perspective views.
Neutral biped stance, palms inward; do not use large carnivorous teeth or raptor sickle claws.

scale.basis: Godefroit etal2014 descriptive approximate body length, composite anatomy not exact individual measurement.

scientific_limits.en: Primary description combines six partial skulls and many disarticulated skeletons; Fig1 whole skeleton is composite, not one complete fossil. Holotype skull INREC K3/109, other body/integument specimens separately identified.1.5m is approximate descriptive body length, not complete fossil measurement. Featherlike structures interpretation follows original authors; evolutionary homology debated. Density, colour, muscles and pose inferred; tail scales are thin epidermal structures, not osteoderms.
scientific_limits.zh: 原描述综合六件部分头骨及许多散离骨架，图1为合成复原非单件完整化石。正模头骨K3/109与其他体被标本分开。1.5米为概述体长估值，非完整标本实测。羽状结构解释依原作者，演化同源性仍有争论；密度、颜色、肌肉姿势推定。尾鳞薄而属表皮，不做骨甲。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole short-headed biped with featherlike body covering and distinctly scaly long tail, short forelimbs and elongated hindlimbs.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Fig1 composite skeleton and true holotype skull INREC K3/109; Fig2 tail scale K4/94 and K4/117 photos, head filaments K4/22 and thorax K4/33.

description.en: Deiphon barrandei has an inflated rounded glabella and a very narrow segmented trunk framed by long spines. Underside limbs, antennae, colour and thickness are inferred from dorsal fossil evidence, without claims about buoyancy or feeding.
description.zh: Deiphon barrandei 具有膨大的圆形头鞍和被长刺环绕的极窄分节躯干。腹面肢、触角、颜色及体厚由背面化石证据推断，不据此主张浮力机制或摄食方式。

construction_notes: One segmented trunk mesh and grouped spine geometry can preserve visible segmentation within budget.
Do not confuse pleural exoskeletal spines with walking legs; inferred legs sit underneath.
Use restrained brown palette as art, not fossil living-color evidence.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Length follows plate caption; width and height are artistic estimates.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish inflated spherical glabella and extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以球形膨大头鞍配极度缩窄的多刺躯干搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

shape_gate.en: Its distinguishing construction is inflated spherical glabella and extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
shape_gate.zh: 以球形膨大头鞍配极度缩窄的多刺躯干为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

scientific_limits.en: Ventral limbs, antennae, color, posture and body thickness are inferred, not preserved in the consulted dorsal photograph. The 3.5 cm plate caption anchors approximate length, not an exact reconstructed individual. No buoyancy or feeding behavior is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 腹面肢、触角、颜色、姿态与体厚为推断，并非所查背面照片保存的信息。图版所标3.5厘米仅作为近似长度依据，不是精确个体复原。不主张其浮力机制或摄食行为。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original living stylization of Deiphon barrandei guided by actual fossil photograph, not a specimen replica.
shape_requirements: Preserve original spherical inflated glabella plus extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk.
Large bulbous glabella dominates anterior profile; narrow segmented axial body and separate swept pleural spines, not a broad solid oval shell.
Paired long curved genal spines and paired rear pointed extensions follow dorsal fossil silhouette.
Small lateral eyes remain subordinate; inferred ventral appendages must not obscure dorsal spaces.

assets.author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Whole-adult woolly rhinoceros, Coelodonta antiquitatis, combining fossil and permafrost evidence with a substantial oval nasal-horn base. Proportions are approximate, not a cast of one specimen; fur, colour, soft tissue, pose and full horn curvature remain artistic choices.
description.zh: 披毛犀 Coelodonta antiquitatis 成体全身复原，综合化石与冻土材料，鼻角采用厚实椭圆基部。体比例为近似值，非单一标本翻模；毛量、颜色、软组织、姿势与完整角弯度仍属美术选择。

art_direction.construction: Original controlled profile lofts for trunk, cheek, neck and tapered limbs; shaped horn sweeps with ellipse-changing cross sections. Continuous intentional transitions and mixed flat/smooth normals. No untouched sphere/cylinder collage.
art_direction.palette: Muted warm umber body, subdued warm-brown dorsal mane, lighter muzzle/undercoat, charcoal eyes and hooves, warm dark keratin. No speculative stripes or glossy toy finish.
art_direction.target_view: Readable at museum card size, with deliberate medium-range contour detail; no microscopic fidelity claim.
art_direction.texture_policy: No image textures, alpha cards, displacement, particle fur or external bitmap dependencies. Material colors are original design choices, not specimen color claims.

diagnostic_targets: Long heavy trunk and deep chest on short strong legs; raised withers flow into a gently declining back and rounded rump. Avoid a tall elephant-like outline or a hippo body with a pasted-on cone.

Two median keratin horns. The anterior nasal horn is distinctly longer and gently swept backward, with a broad fore-aft oval base, tapering into a compressed distal shaft. The shorter frontal horn is separate and more upright behind it. Both attach to real volumes, never a floating spike.

The main horn base fore-aft-to-transverse ratio is approximately 1.5. Preserve obvious width at attachment and taper; do not flatten the base into a razor blade or copy the broken MM 3074 stump as a whole horn.

An elongated low-carried head with a substantial cheek, tapered neck, blunt muzzle, recessed small lateral eyes and two compact pointed ears set high at the rear of the head. Eyes are not forward-facing predator eyes.
Exactly three short hoofed toes per foot, with a broad middle toe and smaller flanking toes. Four feet have visible clearance, plausible joint transitions and grounded support.

Dense coat conveyed through deliberately faceted body volume, a restrained darker mane/withers region and sparse low-profile fur edge breaks; no thousands of hairs, isolated porcupine cones, fur-covered eyes, or noisy random triangles.
Short tapered tail near the rump, not a long modern-rhino whip. Two-horn/woolly/low-long-trunk combination distinguishes this asset structurally from other rhinoceroses, not by size or palette alone.
frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet grounded quadrupedal stance, head carried low, mouth closed, subtle longitudinal leg staggering to expose all four feet. No extreme action or snow-shoveling claim.

scale.status: Modeling targets, not exact specimen measurements. Published adult females support a roughly 3.2–3.6 m head-body length and 1.45–1.65 m withers height. The selected horns synthesize adult examples rather than replicate the shorter horns of MM 7938.

scientific_limits.en: Body proportions are approximate adult reconstruction targets guided by Kolyma and Starunia measurements, not a cast of one specimen. Horn shape varies and preservation can alter it: the nasal horn has a substantial oval base, not the extremely narrow attachment implied by some older reconstructions. Fur volume, living color, muscle contours, posture and full horn curvature are artistic choices. No sex, exact age, paleocoexistence or current conservation status is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 体比例是参考科雷马与斯塔鲁尼亚测量数据的成体复原目标，非单一标本翻模。角形有个体差异且可受保存过程改变：鼻角采用厚实椭圆基部，不照搬部分旧复原中极窄的附着基部。毛量、活体颜色、肌肉轮廓、姿势与完整角弯度为美术选择。不声称性别、准确年龄、同域共生关系或现生保护状态。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole-adult woolly rhinoceros reconstruction synthesizing named fossil and permafrost evidence. It is not a scan, an exact individual restoration, or a behavioral demonstration.

view_plan.additional_views: Only if a concrete unresolved issue requires one, with a recorded reason.
view_plan.preview: Exact same bytes as perspective permitted.
view_plan.website_delivery: No website render compatibility claim at prep. Keep the four diagnostic views. If the actual verified website renderer/config can also serve perspective adequately, document that substitution before rendering; otherwise integration owns necessary website derivatives.

description.en: Kootenayscolex barbarensis. Body thickness, color, posture and exact bristle counts are interpretations. ROM artwork is an interpretive comparison, not fossil preservation of color. No microgeometry mandate: count simplification must be explicit.
description.zh: Kootenayscolex barbarensis 的示意性活体复原。体厚、颜色、姿态和具体刚毛数量为解释，细小刚毛已简化，不将美术复原颜色视为化石证据。

acceptance_obligations: Distinct animal silhouette and anatomical brief compliance in four exact-GLB views.
Portable embedded GLB, source reopening and scoped technical checks; independent review separate.
Mark GPU, world scene, user acceptance and deployment unverified until actually checked.

art_direction.construction: Original coherent lofts, controlled tapered appendages and readable negative space; no floating parts or mechanically stacked primitives.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Ceilings only, not density targets. Spend geometry on diagnostic anatomy and continuous attachments; no hidden microdetail.

morphology.obligation: Segmented worm widest at middle and tapering to both ends; choose a bounded20-segment interpretation within observed up-to25, not species-fixed count.
Two long anterior palps plus a distinctly SHORT median antenna, attached continuously. Head carries chaetae near mouth; no large eyes or jaws invented.
Bilateral parapodia with distinguishable dorsal and ventral chaetal fans; simplify strand count but preserve fan silhouettes and attachment, not random hairs.
Simple terminal pygidium without appendages; no decorative tail tentacles.

pose.description: Slight gentle body curve on invisible contactplane, palps spread for readability without dramatic knots.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

scale.basis: ROMIP64388 holotype thumbnail inspected; reported size1–30mm. Chosen25mm body length excludes palps/chaetae and is illustrative, not a measurement of fossil.

scientific_limits.en: Body thickness, color, posture and exact bristle counts are interpretations. ROM artwork is an interpretive comparison, not fossil preservation of color. No microgeometry mandate: count simplification must be explicit.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static complete animal for a Cambrian marine region in a prehistoric3Dworld. No rig, animation or game-ready integration claim.

anatomical_anchors: ROMIP64388 holotype thumbnail inspected; reported size1–30mm. Chosen25mm body length excludes palps/chaetae and is illustrative, not a measurement of fossil.

No crest, feathers, naked fenestra holes, detached avian wing pair, ornamental tail vane, platform or copied fossil displacement.
